ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patch localized at the far right distal tip; dense network of high-contrast white linear streaks radiating across the central and lower portions of both lobes; circular high-intensity cluster on the far left distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with prominent jagged peaks; notable large protrusion on the inner left lobe margin adjacent to the median notch; multiple smaller serrations (valleys/peaks) across both lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of circular, high-contrast white and tan pixel groups localized on the outer extremity of the left fluke tip, consistent with surface colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of parallel and intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like patterns) covering the majority of the central and lower ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent surface encrustation on the left lateral tip and exhaustive linear scarring across both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical white pigmentation patch on the right distal tip against a predominantly dark background.
